regions.region: page 1 title, abstract, authors, and article metadata
regions.finding: Confirmed the source title and aggregate Pd/Cu stereodivergent-allenylic-alkylation claim. This is article context, not a standalone experiment.
Conceptual comparison of allylic, propargylic, and allenylic substitution and adjacent stereocenters; it is not an experiment and no record was fabricated.
Two explicitly labeled previous-work generic reactions were classified as literature examples: Pd/DTBM-SEGPHOS allenylic substitution and Ir/Carreira-ligand allenylic substitution.
Generic current Pd/Cu stereodivergent reaction and proposed A/B interconversion were classified as a general scheme; experiment-specific records are assigned to later tables/schemes.

unresolved: Scheme 1 contains generic R/LG groups and does not report experiment-specific scale, yield, or selectivity.

regions.region: page 2 left-column prior-work discussion and current-method rationale
regions.finding: Narrative prior-work claims and mechanistic rationale were linked to Scheme 1 classifications and not expanded into current-paper experiments.

regions.region: page 2 Table 1 reaction header and sections A/B
regions.finding: Five unique Pd-ligand conditions L2–L6 were retained. The repeated L4 condition across sections A/B/C is one experiment; L2/L3 are no-reaction outcomes, and L4/L5/L6 retain yield, directional dr, and available major/minor ee values.

regions.region: page 2 Table 1 section C and footnotes
regions.finding: Ten additional aldimine-esters 2b–2k and two R-L4 complementary rows were retained with explicit shared charges, catalyst/additive loadings, THF volume, room temperature/16 h, citric-acid operation, isolated-yield basis, NMR dr basis, HPLC ee basis, and nr marker.
The prose confirms L2/L3 failures, L4 65%/2:1/>99% ee, and reversed dr for L5/L6; it supplies narrative support to the corresponding Table 1 records without creating duplicates.

unresolved: Table 1 omits atmosphere, purification, product mass, and most minor-diastereomer ee values.
Five mol% of nucleophile is reportedly consumed by L-Pd(allyl)BF4, but no separate product or recovery amount is assigned.

regions.finding: Narrative yield/dr/ee values for 2b/2c/2d/2j and the R-L4 complementary rows were reconciled with Table 1. Separate no-Pd and no-Cu controls are reported; no-Cu is merged with Table 3 entry 2 and no-Pd remains a distinct control.
Narrative scope summaries map to the 33 independent Table 2 drawings on page 4; they are not aggregate duplicate records.
3ab/3ac/3ai/3al values and the one-pot substitution/hydrolysis/ring-closure description for 3ai were linked to their Table 2 records; no unsupported operational details were added.

Eight displayed stereoisomer outcomes were inventoried. (S,S)-3aa and (S,S)-3ag merge with their Table 2 rows; six remaining Pd/Cu configuration combinations are distinct records with directional dr and ee retained.

unresolved: The no-Pd prose control omits a detection limit and operational details.
Scheme 2 omits isolated masses, purification, atmosphere, and minor-diastereomer ee.

regions.finding: Twelve independent aryl-substrate rows were retained with shared 0.30/0.20 mmol charges, Pd/Cu/L1/base loadings, THF 2 mL, room temperature/16 h, isolated yields, dr, and ee.
Six independent alkyl/functionalized-substrate rows were retained with their printed 62–71% yields, >20:1 dr, and >99% ee.
Three distinct ketoprofen-, naproxen-, and ibuprofen-derived experiments were retained with 52/57/54% yields and >20:1 dr. No ee was invented because none is printed beside these drawings.
Twelve aldimine-scope rows were retained; standard (S,S)-3aa and (S,S)-3ag are merged with Scheme 2, and all product-specific yields/dr/ee values retain their own targets.
The no-Cu, NaH/no-Cu, and Cu/dppf controls are linked to the five-row Table 3 on page 5 rather than duplicated from prose.

unresolved: Table 2 omits atmosphere, purification, isolated masses, and drug-entry ee values.
Compact scope structures are label-based with null SMILES where source-safe encoding was uncertain.

regions.finding: Five control conditions were reconciled: standard 1a/Cu-L1 (merged with 3aa), no-Cu 1a and 1p failures, NaH/no-Cu 26%/1:1/82–81% ee, and Cu/dppf 37%/2.5:1/66–14% ee.

The paired time-course plots are one kinetic study. Recovered 1a remains almost racemic, R/S consumption rates are similar, product yield rises, and product dr/ee remain stable; exact plotted point values were not inferred from pixels.
Two distinct experiments use (R)-1a (96% ee) or (S)-1a (98% ee) and give (S,S)-3aa in 69% or 67% with >20:1 dr and >99% ee.

regions.region: page 5 Scheme 3C lower proposed A/Int/B pathway and DFT discussion
regions.finding: A/Int/B interconversion is a mechanism, not three preparations. Figure 1 DFT bond distances/angles begin in the text and continue on page 6.

unresolved: Kinetic point values are not tabulated and were not digitized.
No-Cu nr rows omit analytical detection limits.
DFT intermediates are not isolated structures.

regions.region: page 6 Figure 1 calculated structures and bonding orbitals
regions.finding: DFT distances, distorted C0–C1–C2 angles, and weak C=C/Pd plus strong sigma(Csp2–Pd) interpretation were retained as a mechanism/computational record, not an experiment.
The acetate-assisted A↔B η3–η1–η3 pathway through Int-1–Int-4 is classified as a DFT mechanism; no reaction record or yield was fabricated.
Three distinct 3aa derivatizations to dipeptide 6 (80%), amino acid 7 (97%), and isocyanate 8 (91%) were retained with all printed reagents, solvents, temperatures, dr/ee, and missing times explicit.

regions.region: page 6 Scheme 5 arrows d/e and d/f
regions.finding: The piperidine-9 sequence retains 36% explicitly as a two-step overall yield. The butyrolactone-10 sequence is represented as Ts protection, TFA treatment, and Rh hydrofunctionalization with 65% overall product yield; stage yields/times were not invented.
Summary only; it adds no independent experiment or outcome beyond the tables and schemes already recorded.

unresolved: Scheme 5 omits reagent amounts, times, atmosphere, workups, purifications, and isolated masses.
The amino-acid coupling partner incorporated into dipeptide 6 is not stated in the condition footnote.
CCDC 2195080 is characterization, not an associated SI file or machine-structure verification.
